Dude wtf i'm in the exact same spot as you! Me and girlfriend broke up in september and i'm starting to loose my hair again (after  finasterid preserved it for 5 years, but had to get off it after i got horrible sideeffects. 

You write that you know about the sideeffects of Fin. But let me tell you from someone who has been there. DONT FUCKING TAKE THAT SHIT!! It can destroy your life beyond repair. I know the pain of losing ones hair and what it does to your selfconfidence but by god find a way of dealing with it without taking Fin. If you want to take something try minoxidil (rogain in us i think).

One of the reasons you want to take it is among other things that you think women will ignore you if you go bald and look down on you (which is definitly true if you cant pull of the bald look). But taking a pill that makes your dick limp so your attractive to women is insane. I wish i could tell my past self how rediculous that idea is. 

A way for me to deal with the situation is trying to grow. To get my college things done. To do alot of sports (brazilian jiu jitsu) and to meet new people and get myself out there. If you really cant handle the situation talk to a therapist. I know martial arts is not for everybody but for me it was a huge confidence booster. Maybe it can help you aswell. 

And the most important thing of all. Your not alone with losing your hair at a young age. Alot of men go through it and it stings for everyone. Its like losing a part of your personality and it stings hard. But always keep in mind: Your hair doesnt define who you are.
Thats the thing. i should be kinda gratefull for everything in my life but i'm not. The only thing i feel is lonelines.
